mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%) signals potential monetary tightening, causing equity valuations to contract and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in labor market strength (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) and housing starts (HOUST growth > 0.3%) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth > 0.3%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS growth > 0.4%) signal sustained corporate hiring and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.4%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25% in 3 months) signals monetary tightening, causing equity valuations to contract and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 108.0) signals a weakening economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 108.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0%) signals robust economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS growth > 0.5%) and housing starts (HOUST growth > 0.3%) signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth > 0.3%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
